藏品名称_EN: cup stand with the eight buddhist treasures
描述_EN: (the traditional eighth treasure, a parasol, has been substituted here by a pair of elephant tusks.) after the fourteenth century these symbols, not necessarily in a group of eight, appeared on metalwork, porcelains, and textiles in china and tibet. the objects resting on lotus buds on the interior of this cup stand represent seven of the eight buddhist treasures: a wheel, an endless knot, a conch shell, a victory banner, lotus flowers, a pair of fish, and a treasure vase.
描述_ZN: （传统的第八件宝物，一把阳伞，在这里被一对象牙所代替。）十四世纪以后，这些符号，不一定是八个一组的，出现在中国和西藏的金属制品、瓷器和纺织品上。 此杯架内侧的莲花蕾上放置的物品代表了佛教八宝中的七宝：车轮、无尽结、海螺壳、胜利旗帜、莲花、一对鱼和一个宝瓶。
